items.title: Intuitive Initiative Squads & alignment
items.do: Start a combat with Aveline, Durgan, Ogre Chieftain, Orc Warrior, and 4 Goblin Sneaks, then open Initiative. Try Auto-Squad Minions, Ungroup All, "+ Squad" / "+ Add" popovers, checkbox multi-select + "Group Selected into Squad", dragging one enemy onto another or into a squad, clicking "×" on a member pill, and rolling Initiative.
items.expect: Minions auto-group into visual brass-bordered Squad Cards ("×2 · 1 roll") sharing one row of Check/Roll/Boons/Banes controls; popovers aren't clipped; rolling rolls once per squad while each member keeps its own turn; all buttons, pills, checkboxes, and icons sit cleanly centered.

items.title: Polyhedral SVG dice & conditional Bloodied/Strained entry
items.do: With Aveline (Sworn Blade) or Durgan (Drawing Light), attack a healthy Orc Warrior and expand both the 2d12 roll breakdown and the damage dice breakdown; then apply enough damage to make the target Bloodied or Strained (and try Undo).
items.expect: Expanded dice render as true tabletop shapes (d4 triangle, d6 square, d8 diamond, d10 kite, d12 pentagon) with centered numbers and gold exploded "!" glow; the Bloodied/Strained line stays hidden while the target is healthy and appears only when the target actually is Bloodied/Strained (hiding again on Undo).

items.title: Encounter Log HP Bar header, Undo voiding & clean turn log
items.do: In combat with Durgan, Sylwen, Orc Warrior, and Ogre Chieftain: apply damage to Ogre Chieftain then click Undo; have Durgan use Judge (0 AP) and Shield of Faith (Reaction) during Orc Warrior's turn (applying Taunted), then open Encounter Log and click Copy for Analysis.
items.expect: The summary column header reads "HP Bar" (not "Pressure"); undone damage is voided so Net matches Max HP − Current; the Turn-by-Turn log prefixes off-turn actions ("Durgan Judge 0A vs OW"), writes "Taunted (Durgan)" without nested build text, and shows "Durgan Rx Shield of Faith vs Sylwen" once without duplication.
